relative_lambda_component.mathematics: Reassociate interactive lambda Q*(R*V) as (Q*R)*V; floating reduction order changes, so the candidate remains separately gated.
relative_lambda_component.method: One warmup per graph; three alternating-order timed executions per variant; allocation and activation transfers excluded from the timed compute; full outputs compared plus 64 independent double-precision scalar samples.
relative_lambda_component.measurement_limitation: This early short run recorded medians and process totals, but not individual timing samples or an at-run binary digest. Later source adds raw samples; none are invented for this run. Ratios describe this component, not complete model speed.

local_lambda_component.mathematics: Project each query through the learned spatial kernel, then contract the coefficients with row-strip V neighborhoods; add the exact Q dot bias term. The F32 reduction order changes.
local_lambda_component.budget_scope: The cap applies to patch and coefficient tensors per strip, including both the original and padded patch copies when padding is selected. It is not total graph memory, halos, query transforms or retained partial outputs.
local_lambda_component.padding_semantics: CPU-only zeros align the query-key reduction and neighborhood reduction to multiples of 16; the original learned coefficients and image geometry remain unchanged. Floating-point reduction order can change.
local_lambda_component.scalar_oracle: Independent double-precision zero-padded convolution followed by Q reduction; full small-fixture outputs and explicit both-sides seam samples at model geometries.
